pages.text: Inferno doesn't provoke aggresion from Dragons when held near dragons. It does not prevent other conditions such as wearing armour from provoking aggression. $(br2)When the durability reaches 1, Inferno will be considered empty, it will stop taking durability damage (so it never breaks) & will stop working until it is repaired with a Dragon Blade Canister. $(br2)Despite its strength, it too, was lost to the Dragon Hunters.
